description: This file defines a fragment for an Android TV application using the Leanback library. It constructs a home screen with multiple rows of content cards, handles UI setup, and provides custom presentation logic for content cards with focus visuals and placeholder images.

classes.name: SimpleContentCardData
classes.description: Data class representing a simple card with title and subtitle for content display.

classes.name: PosterCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for displaying content cards with focus visuals, using ImageCardView and placeholder images.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: Fragment that builds the home screen with multiple content rows, manages UI setup and data binding.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a ViewHolder containing an ImageCardView with custom focus behavior.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the card view, setting title, subtitle, and placeholder image.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image when the view holder is unbound.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI and constructs content rows after the activity is created.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the fragment's title, header state, and colors.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs and sets the adapter with multiple content rows with sample items.
